title: Pentaho BI Developer - RD Practitioner
description: Hands-on workshop for Pentaho Report Designer: data sources, report elements and groups, calculations, formatting, parameters, charts, sub-reports, and publishing to the BA repository.

assistant.subject: Pentaho Report Designer
suggestions: How do I add a group and a group header to a report?
What's the difference between a Details band and a Group band?
How do I create a calculated field with the Formula Editor?
How do I publish a report to the Pentaho Server?

moduleSummaries.title: Please read ...!
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the best from this lab guide - read this five-minute orientation before you begin the course.

moduleSummaries.title: Navigating Report Designer
moduleSummaries.summary: Tour the Report Designer workspace: welcome screen, toolbars, tabs, palettes, and previewing sample reports.

moduleSummaries.title: Data Sources & Queries
moduleSummaries.summary: Connect Report Designer to your data: JDBC connections, queries, and the data sets that drive every report.

moduleSummaries.title: Report Elements & Groups
moduleSummaries.summary: Lay out data elements on the canvas and group rows into report sections with headers and footers.

moduleSummaries.title: Calculations
moduleSummaries.summary: Add formulas and functions to reports: conditional formatting driven by data, and group / report totals.

moduleSummaries.title: Formatting the Report
moduleSummaries.summary: Polish the report: headers, footers, fonts, spacing, and the visual details that make reports read well.

moduleSummaries.title: Report Parameters
moduleSummaries.summary: Let report users filter at run time with parameters — prompts, defaults, and parameter-driven queries.

moduleSummaries.title: Charts & Sub Reports
moduleSummaries.summary: Visualise data with charts, embed sub-reports, and build drill-down interactions between them.

moduleSummaries.title: Publishing Reports
moduleSummaries.summary: Publish finished reports to the BA repository and link reports together with hyperlinks.

moduleSummaries.title: Capstone Project
moduleSummaries.summary: Build, chart, parameterise, and publish a management-ready regional sales report - every module in one project.

moduleSummaries.title: Reference
moduleSummaries.summary: Appendices from the course manual: data sources, chart types, environment variables, and report templates.
